evals.prompt: The included launch film is 15 seconds at 60fps, with approved exact narration and supplied logo/UI assets. Sound reports -16 LUFS and -1.1 dBTP; the JSON contract passes but nobody has decoded, watched or listened to the actual mux. Prepare a delivery review, owners and evidence requirements without claiming the output passes.
evals.expected_output: Separates structural/reported/file-presence evidence from decoded properties, actual master/mux measurement, mux-sync cue offsets and yuv420p colour range, full visual/listening/sync, caption/accessibility and rights checks. Uses saved destination targets; names owners and unverified acceptance dimensions.
evals.comparison: same brief with and without Skill; structured brief and simple prose brief are paired separately

evals.prompt: Please check a two-second logo greeting. The manifest says r1 but Copy changed Hello world to Hello again in the current timeline. We have only the JSON and SRT; no audio is attached. Explain the next steps and a useful review handoff without pretending you heard it.
evals.expected_output: Computes or requests the canonical current fingerprint, rejects stale audio and routes reissue through Motion/Sound/Chris. Metadata-only checks omit file presence claims; no decoded/listening/rights approval is invented.
evals.comparison: same brief with and without Skill; structured brief and simple prose brief are paired separately

evals.prompt: Revise the static homepage headline into three alternatives using this approved positioning. Do not add video, sound or animation; the deliverable is plain text for Copy review.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the unrelated control static and routes ordinary copy work without media production, runtime installation, providers or unnecessary audiovisual review.
evals.comparison: unrelated control; media Skill should not activate

evals.prompt: Review a 10-second 30fps (300 frames) Remotion export where contract validation passed, but ffprobe reports yuvj420p(pc, bt709) and decoded waveform vs visual frame inspection shows cue-grow landing at frame 198 instead of timeline cue 178 (+20.02 frames) while a draft report claims sync via timeline-arithmetic. Run the final-mux sync/range gate and assign owners.
evals.expected_output: Runs review.mjs mux-sync --timeline media/timeline.json --manifest media/audio-manifest.json --sync media/specs/mux-sync.json; rejects timeline-arithmetic sync claims (muxSync.method), rejects unapproved yuvj420p full-range output (muxSync.colorRange), and rejects discrete cue offset > 1.0 frame (muxSync.cueDrift). Routes visual beat-grid/encoding fixes to Motion Designer (check-prompt-spec.mjs --timeline and imageFormat: 'png' + yuv420p) and keeps human listening explicitly unverified.
evals.comparison: same brief with and without Skill; verify deterministic failure codes and owner routing
